about: Combined in-context references, built exactly as the Sept 2026 Kaggle runs built them: each clip cleaned (24 kHz mono, 60 Hz high-pass, silence-trimmed, -20 LUFS), ranked, joined with 0.35 s gaps, with the matching transcript. Use a file as-is to reproduce those runs.

qwen3-tts.text: Almost every one of these countries wrote me a letter of thank you. The Prime Minister of Pakistan, terrific man, said that Donald Trump was responsible for saving thirty million lives and probably many more than that. The President of Azerbaijan said President Trump in six months did a miracle. It was an absolute miracle that nobody thought could be done.
